Class DuringEvent

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.cards.Card
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.Building
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.forEvent.DuringEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
DuringHunt, DuringPaintings, DuringRitual, DuringSustenance
public abstract class DuringEvent extends Building
Abstract base for buildings whose effect activates during an event resolution (i.e. when one of Trigger.HUNT, Trigger.SHAMANIC_RITUAL, Trigger.SUSTENANCE, or Trigger.CAVE_PAINTINGS fires).

Subclasses implement execute(Set, Trigger) to define the specific bonus; this class filters the incoming trigger against the set of event triggers before delegating.
